Assign rows using a Gaussian mixture model.

Fits a Gaussian mixture to selected numeric features and appends Int32 cluster_id; with Probabilities on, also probability_0..k-1 (each row's chance of each component). Rows missing a feature get nulls.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `GMMCluster` |
| Search words | gmm, gaussian, mixture, clustering, soft |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional label column excluded from automatic feature detection. |
|   | n_components | `n_components` | Integer | `3` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Number of mixture components. |
|   | covariance_type | `covariance_type` | Choice | `full` | `full`, `tied`, `diag`, `spherical` | The run | Covariance model. |
|   | max_iter | `max_iter` | Integer | `100` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Maximum fit iterations. |
|   | tol | `tol` | Number | `0.001` |   | The run | Convergence tolerance. |
|   | n_init | `n_init` | Integer | `1` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Independent initializations. |
|   | seed | `seed` | Integer | `0` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Random seed; 0 selects nondeterministic initialization. |
|   | standardise | `standardise` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Scale each feature to z-scores before fitting (Explore > Groups does) |
|   | probabilities | `probabilities` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Also add probability_0..k-1, each row's chance of each component. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
